concerns.text: FR-003 ends with “(see FR‑)” – the referenced requirement ID is missing, so the procedure for computing raw p‑values using effective sample size cannot be located or verified.
The edge‑case description for missing helium abundance cites “see SC‑XX”, but no SC‑XX is defined elsewhere in the document, leaving the expected behaviour untestable.

User Story 2 mandates correlation on the *full continuous* dataset, while the Idea document (and the earlier “Methodology sketch”) describes filtering for storm events (Dst < ‑50 nT). This contradictory requirement makes it unclear which data subset the tests should use, rendering the FRs unverifiable until the conflict is resolved.
